svg.title: DeepSeek Harness Code — Code Agent Desktop Architecture
svg.desc: DeepSeek Harness Code is a Code Agent desktop system. Electron Main owns lifecycle and the loopback Harness child. The secure preload bridge exposes only five fixed capability groups: preferences, lanAccess, runtime, updater, and bundledPlugins. BrowserWindow hosts Harness Web UI augmented by official Cordis plugins. Harness runs as a loopback child on system Node with official Home, public-CLI plugin reconciliation, and persistent sessions. Anchored Standard, Prompt Principles, Superpowers, Vision Router and Routing Suite shape the Code Agent loop. Isolated Watchdog provides bounded recovery. Provider boundary stays at DeepSeek API.
svg.text: DeepSeek Harness Code — Code Agent Desktop System
Electron 43 · @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 · System Node ≥22.13 · Loopback-only · pnpm 11.19.0 · asar:false
Vision: A durable Code Agent, not a chat wrapper — plan → use tools → verify → deliver, across long sessions, with memory, recovery, and desktop-native control.
Code Agent = Persistent session + Tool-rich loop + Skills knowledge + Human-in-the-loop approvals + Recoverable runtime. DHC makes it installable.
No network · OS IPC pipe only
contextIsolation: true · sandbox: true · nodeIntegration: false · createSecureWebPreferences
No shell · No arbitrary IPC · No credential/prompt logging · Navigation policy
Harness owns prose/rendering/timing — plugin hosts portal only
Loopback HTTP + SSE · 5s timeout · Sessions persisted
Goal → Plan → Todo → Tools → Jobs → Workflow → Compaction
Tools: bash / str_replace_editor / fs / search / web / subagent / workflow / ralph
Checkpoints · Session history · Approval / userQuestions protocol preserved
IPC stencil: agent/pre-step · system-prompt/assemble · session/event · no private wire mutation
Intelligence Plane — Model + Tool Surface + Knowledge Injection
No weight bundling · no hidden CoT
Harness owns normal reconciliation · desktop only removes 0.1.1-rc.2 linkOnly duplicates after CLI success

Bundles: desktop-plugin · dsh-ui-motion · dsh-model2-selector · dsh-ui-polish · dsh-updater-check · dsh-lan-access · prompt-principles · vision-router · better-sidebar · superpowers · composition · injector · mode-boost · dsh-find-plugin
dsh-home: settings / credentials / sessions / workspaces / .agent-presets / skills
Legacy migration: copy-only · target-wins · symlink reject · 0600/0700 · idempotent
Electron / Harness / Watchdog logs · redacted · 10MB ×5 rotation · openLogs
npm install -g dsh@pinned · fail-open · never overwrite user global
preflight: 51 artifacts · 35 deps · 8 critical · 10 bundles · SHA-256 verified
Streaming · retry policy · no private wire patch
3 probes fail / child exit → serialized restart
quit: cancel recovery · watchdog ack · SIGTERM 8s → SIGKILL · isolated renderer errors
Dock / Tray / Menu · single instance lock
No parallel wire format — official protocol only
No request replay · no overlapping recovery
Not a web wrapper · Not a model launcher
Not a fork of Harness protocol
Respects official Home + CLI + session model
Roadmap: benchmarks · Linux GA · fault injection
Electron Main owns window/child/bridge · Harness owns sessions/protocol · Watchdog owns relaunch · Preload owns validation
Packaging: asar:false (empty client graph inside ASAR on 0.1.1-rc.2) · extraResources immutable · build verifies SHA-256 before tar · no runtime routing download
